name: browserstack-automate-selenium-java
label: Selenium Java
triggers: Selenium with Java, Maven, Gradle, TestNG, JUnit, RemoteWebDriver, browserstack-java-sdk or browserstack.yml
toolchain_check: `java -version` (11+), the project's build tool (`mvn -version` for Maven; `./gradlew -v` or `gradle -v` for Gradle), `git --version`
platform_kind: real desktop browsers and real mobile devices
own_platforms_yaml:
- os: Windows
    osVersion: 11
    browserName: chrome
    browserVersion: latest
  - os: OS X
    osVersion: Sequoia
    browserName: safari
    browserVersion: latest
  - deviceName: Samsung Galaxy S23
    osVersion: 13.0
    browserName: chrome
  - deviceName: iPhone 15
    osVersion: 17
    browserName: safari
own_platforms_text: Windows 11 Chrome, macOS Sequoia Safari, a real Samsung Galaxy S23 (Chrome) and a real iPhone 15 (Safari)
